label: Net sales
definition: Sum of net line amounts of completed orders

label: Orders
definition: Completed orders with at least one valid line

label: Active customers
definition: Distinct customers with a completed order

label: Gross margin
definition: Net sales - quantity x catalog unit cost

label: Cancellation rate
definition: Cancelled orders / all orders with valid lines

label: Net sales, latest month
definition: Net sales of the last month in the data

label: Growth vs same month last year
definition: (latest month - same month one year earlier) / same month one year earlier

label: Growth, last 12 vs prior 12 months
definition: (last 12 months - the 12 months before) / the 12 months before

label: Top category
definition: Category with the highest net sales

label: Top product
definition: Product with the highest net sales
